purpose: Task-local source re-attestation for the M2 product-manager review.

facts.fact: The adapter binds one exact Codex thread to a durable target claim and derives UI serialization from the complete browser/profile/tab/session identity.
Send and wait state preserve the thread, target, idempotency, URL, and no-resend boundary used by every batch child.

Six CreateNew capacity claims are serialized by a short mutex; per-thread three and global six limits are enforced before launching a child, and release requires durable pre-click-unsent or terminal proof.

Batch manifests are contained, identity-bound, and unique; run-batch-root queues locally, launches existing run-root children, preserves partial results, and emits atomic terminal batch evidence without model polling.
Cross-process stdlib locks, atomic JSON replacement, and atomic session directory allocation replace check-then-create and direct status writes.

Batch creation produces independent session/round/evidence directories; batch import validates exact thread, result mapping, terminal state, target, URL, hashes, watcher, and acknowledgement while preserving partial failures.
Task evidence and response persistence use locked atomic read-modify-write with task/thread/session/round deduplication and conflicting-response rejection.
